name: cv-tailor
description: Codex workflow for source-grounded, ATS-safe CV tailoring from user context and job descriptions.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor source-backed ATS CVs for specific jobs.
interface.longDescription: CV Tailor guides Codex through candidate context gathering, profile grounding, job evaluation, human review, source-backed CV generation, and ATS-safe PDF rendering. User data stays in a workspace-local .cv-tailor folder.
defaultPrompt: Tailor my CV for this job description.
Ground my profile from my CV and projects.
Generate an ATS PDF after I approve the plan.
